deliverables.description: A report specifying the data requirements, documenting the gathered information, presenting data-quality and statistical validation results, and stating a judgment on fitness for the intended analysis.

information_nodes.description: The decision or analysis scope, target variables, population and time coverage, constraints, and intended use of the information.
Raw or extracted records available for the analysis, including observed values and record-level identifiers.
Field definitions, units, collection notes, provenance, and other metadata needed to interpret the source records correctly.
Applicable data-quality criteria, statistical testing conventions, and acceptance considerations for validation.
Specify the variables, units, coverage, granularity, and acceptable quality criteria needed for the intended analysis.
Gather and map relevant records to the defined requirements, producing the candidate dataset for validation.
Evaluate completeness, accuracy, consistency, validity, and timeliness of the candidate data against the defined requirements and applicable criteria.
Determine appropriate statistical checks based on variable types, sample structure, quality concerns, and the analysis purpose.
Apply the selected tests to detect anomalies, inconsistencies, coverage gaps, and distributional issues in the candidate data.
Synthesize the quality assessment and statistical validation results to judge whether the information meets requirements, noting limitations and needed remediation.

work_objective: Define data requirements and gather, validate, and judge the fitness of information for an operations research analysis using appropriate statistical tests and professional judgment.
